45. वोल्टता V1 पर शक्ति P1 का एक प्रतिरोधक, वोल्टता V2 पर शक्ति P2 के प्रतिरोधक से श्रेणी में जुड़ा है। समतुल्य प्रतिरोध होगा
(A) V1²/P1 + V2²/P2 (B) P1²/V1 + P2²/V2 (C) (P1+P2)/(V1+V2)² (D) P1/V1² + P2/V2²
raw.en:
44 (cont.) The upper part of a box-type solar cooker has a glass cover. The reason for this is
(A) to see whether the food kept inside the cooker is being cooked or not (B) to prevent loss of heat due to radiation (C) to prevent the passage of dust into the box (D) none of these

45. A resistor of power P1 at voltage of V1 is connected in series with another resistor of power P2 at voltage V2. The equivalent resistance will be
(A) V1²/P1 + V2²/P2 (B) P1²/V1 + P2²/V2 (C) (P1+P2)/(V1+V2)² (D) P1/V1² + P2/V2²

notes: This page has Q44's English continuation (start of page) plus full bilingual Q45. No pen-marks visible on this page.
